audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[0..4].side read "Skill" on all five early rows while content win[0..4] read "Hwei" — five cross-layer disagreements on one page.
audit.why: Packet levelChart matches the content layer (Hwei x5, then Azir x2). His paint palettes cycle at 6-10s against Azir's 8-14s Q and 16-22s E, so the early lane is his.
audit.corrected: Both layers on Hwei x5 / Azir x2, ratings raised on the early rows, and all five whys rewritten to argue his side from his kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] named "Fated Painting", and the late-game text built toward "Shard of Spectral Truth" — neither exists in the kit or on Azir's build path. whys[3] also claimed Hwei is "fully mobile".
audit.why: Hwei's Q palette contains Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt and Molten Fissure. Azir's scaling items are Nashor's Tooth and Rabadon's. Hwei has no dash at all — the page's own mid field says so.
audit.corrected: Real spell names, real items, and the 4-5 gap restated on cooldown cadence rather than invented mobility.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to his CC used the fabricated name "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" — nine fields including focus.text. The packet flags that the page never names a single real Hwei ability. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit.
audit.why: The CC palette is Subject: Torment (E, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10) holding Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. Q is Subject: Disaster (10/9/8/7/6), W is Subject: Serenity (18-16), R is Spiraling Despair (120/100/80, 1300). His passive, Signature of the Visionary, completes on the SECOND damaging spell to hit you — which is the interaction that decides every trade and was absent entirely.
audit.corrected: Real names throughout, real cooldowns in the cooldowns field, and the Signature two-spell rule made the trading rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad described a generic engage window that Hwei, a champion with no dash, does not have.
audit.why: His punish is the Signature detonation, not a gap-close. The first paint that touches you is the cue to leave, because the second one completes the passive.
audit.corrected: tradeBad and breakdown.trading rewritten around the Signature.

edits.before: With Shard of Spectral Truth / core mage items your soldiers finally out-range and out-damage his combo pieces, and your R wall shuts down his engage options completely. notes: The packet defect was right: this page named none of Hwei's real abilities. "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" appeared in nine fields including focus.text and is fabricated — the CC palette is Subject: Torment (E). "Fated Painting" (spikes[0]) and the item "Shard of Spectral Truth" (late) are also inventions. The Signature of the Visionary two-spell rule — the passive that actually decides trades here — was missing entirely and is now the trading rule. whys[3] called Hwei "fully mobile" when he has no dash. Report sweep cap respected: only report[0].t and report[1].t rewritten; report[3].t, report[4].t, report[5].t and report[9].t still carry the fabricated ability name and should be swept in a follow-up.
